career_ladder.note: Civilian Group 'C' staff in the Indian Air Force are recruited across Air Commands, Air Force Stations, and Base Repair Depots (BRDs). Posts range from Multi Tasking Staff (MTS / Mess Staff, Pay Level 1) to Lower Division Clerk (LDC / Storekeeper, Pay Level 2). Promotions follow standard Central Government non-gazetted civilian cadres up to Office Superintendent / Assistant level.

exam_scheme.note: Selection for IAF Civilian Group 'C' posts is conducted through a Written Examination followed by a Skill, Practical, or Physical Test wherever applicable. The written test is based on the minimum educational qualification (10th/12th standard) and consists of 100 objective-type questions of 120 minutes duration across four sections: General Intelligence and Reasoning (25), Numerical Aptitude (25), General English (25), and General Awareness (25). Negative marking of 0.25 marks applies where notified. The skill test (e.g. typing test of 35 wpm in English or 30 wpm in Hindi for LDC; trade test for cook/carpenter) is qualifying in nature.

financial_package.note: Civilian Group 'C' personnel in the Indian Air Force are governed by the central 7th CPC Pay Matrix. Multi Tasking Staff (MTS) posts enter at Pay Level 1 (entry basic ₹18,000 to ₹56,900), while Lower Division Clerk (LDC) and Storekeeper posts enter at Pay Level 2 (entry basic ₹19,900 to ₹63,200). Staff receive Central Government Dearness Allowance, HRA, Transport Allowance, and defence civilian facilities.
financial_package.pay_source_label: IAF Group 'C' Recruitment Advt. — Pay Scale for MTS (Level 1) & LDC (Level 2)
financial_package.estimate_note: Entry basic ₹18,000 (Level 1 MTS) to ₹19,900 (Level 2 LDC) + 58% DA (₹10,440 to ₹11,542) + HRA (10%-30%: ₹1,800 to ₹5,970) + Transport Allowance (₹1,422 to ₹2,844) yields gross ~₹31,000 to ~₹39,000. In-hand reflects ~10% NPS deduction and standard deductions.
official_perks: Residential accommodation in Air Force civilian quarters or central HRA
Comprehensive medical facilities under CGHS or Station Medicare Centres (SMC) for civilian employees
CSD Canteen smart card privileges across Air Force stations and Base Repair Depots
National Pension System (NPS) with 14% defined monthly employer contribution
Children Education Allowance (CEA) of ₹2,250 per month per child and Leave Travel Concession (LTC)
